# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user nginx;
worker_processes auto;
pid /run/nginx.pid;

events {
	worker_connections 768;
}

http {
	sendfile on;
	tcp_nopush on;
	types_hash_max_size 2048;

	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	default_type application/octet-stream;

	##
	# SSL Settings (Debian 12 default)
	##
	ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; # Dropping SSLv3, ref: POODLE
	ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

	access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;
	error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;

	#gzip on;

	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/m5cet.conf:
# =============================================================================
# M5cet — Nginx config for a STATIC install with app + admin under ONE domain.
#
# nginx serves the built SPA (dist/public) directly and reverse-proxies only the
# dynamic parts:
#
#   /            -> static SPA          (dist/public, copied to the `root` below)
#   /assets/     -> static, long cache  (Vite content-hashed files)
#   /api/        -> app backend         (127.0.0.1:5000)  REST + push + AI/speech/telephony
#   /ws          -> app backend         (WebSocket signaling, rate-limited)
#   /goodbye     -> app backend         (Clear & Quit landing, sends Clear-Site-Data)
#   /hooks/      -> app backend         (Functions webhooks: models called from outside)
#   /fn-sandbox.html -> app backend     (the sandboxed frame a function's browser code runs in)
#   /admin/      -> admin backend       (127.0.0.1:5050)  token-protected admin API + SSE
#   /console     -> admin backend "/"   (the admin GUI)
#
# Deploy steps:
#   1) npm run build                # -> dist/public, dist/index.cjs, dist/admin.cjs
#   2) sudo mkdir -p /var/www/m5cet && sudo cp -r dist/public/* /var/www/m5cet/
#   3) run the app:    PORT=5000 node dist/index.cjs
#      run the admin:  ENABLE_ADMIN=1 ADMIN_API_TOKEN=<secret> ADMIN_PORT=5050 ADMIN_BIND=127.0.0.1 node dist/admin.cjs
#      (use systemd units or the docker-compose admin profile; keep both on 127.0.0.1)
#   4) put this file at /etc/nginx/sites-available/m5cet.conf, symlink into
#      sites-enabled, set your domain + TLS below, then: sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
#
# HTTPS is effectively required: getUserMedia (audio/video), WebRTC, Web NFC,
# Web Serial, WebAuthn/PassKey and Clear-Site-Data all need a secure context.
# For a quick localhost test you may copy the 443 block onto `listen 80` and drop
# the ssl_* lines.
# =============================================================================

# ---- Upstreams (change host:port here if you run them elsewhere) ------------
upstream m5cet_app   { server 127.0.0.1:5000; keepalive 16; }
upstream m5cet_admin { server 127.0.0.1:5050; keepalive 8; }

# ---- Rate / connection limiting for the WebSocket upgrade path --------------
# (the app's own WS limiter does not run on the upgrade, so we enforce it here)
limit_req_zone  $binary_remote_addr zone=m5cet_ws:10m   rate=30r/m;
limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=m5cet_conn:10m;

# ---- WebSocket upgrade mapping ----------------------------------------------
map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade {
    default upgrade;
    ''      close;
}

# ---- gzip (static text assets) ----------------------------------------------
gzip            on;
gzip_vary       on;
gzip_comp_level 6;
gzip_min_length 1024;
gzip_types      text/plain text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml application/manifest+json;

# =============================================================================
# HTTP :80 — ACME challenge + redirect to HTTPS
# =============================================================================
server {
    listen      80;
    listen      [::]:80;
    server_name chat.example.org;          # <-- your domain

    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/certbot; }   # certbot webroot
    location / { return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }
}

# =============================================================================
# HTTPS :443 — the app + admin, one domain
# =============================================================================
server {
    listen      443 ssl;
    listen      [::]:443 ssl;
    http2       on;                        # nginx < 1.25.1: remove this and use `listen 443 ssl http2;`
    server_name chat.example.org;          # <-- your domain

    # --- TLS (certbot --nginx fills these, or point them at your certs) ------
    ssl_certificate     /etc/m5test/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/m5test/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols       TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers         HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    ssl_session_cache   shared:m5cet_ssl:10m;
    ssl_session_timeout 1d;

    access_log /var/log/nginx/m5cet.access.log;
    error_log  /var/log/nginx/m5cet.error.log;

    # STT audio upload (/api/speech/stt) is capped at 10 MiB app-side; give it room.
    # (Inline chat attachments travel P2P over the DataChannel, not through nginx.)
    client_max_body_size 12m;

    # --- Static SPA (served by nginx, not the node app) ----------------------
    root  /var/www/m5cet;                  # <-- copy dist/public/* here
    index index.html;

    # NOTE ON HEADERS: nginx `add_header` in a location REPLACES any inherited
    # add_header from the server block. So the security headers live INSIDE each
    # static location (below); the proxied /api /admin locations deliberately do
    # NOT add them — the node app's own helmet middleware sets them there, and we
    # avoid sending a second, conflicting CSP.

    # Content-hashed assets: cache hard, but still send the safe subset.
    location /assets/ {
        try_files $uri =404;
        # The build writes name.js.gz / .br next to each asset (script/build.ts).
        gzip_static on;
        # brotli_static on;   # with the ngx_brotli module
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
    }

    # SPA shell + any other root static file: never cache the HTML, full CSP.
    location / {
        try_files $uri /index.html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-store" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer" always;
        add_header Permissions-Policy "geolocation=(self), microphone=(self), camera=(self)" always;
        add_header X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" always;
        add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
        add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' wss: ws: https://tile.openstreetmap.org; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://api.fontshare.com https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tile.openstreetmap.org; font-src 'self' https://api.fontshare.com https://fonts.gstatic.com; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self'; child-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'" always;
    }

    # --- 6.2: map preview tiles, through the app ------------------------------
    # Not in the access log: a tile's coordinates next to the visitor's
    # address say where someone was looking (the app keeps no record either).
    location /api/map/tile/ {
        access_log off;
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
        proxy_read_timeout    30s;
    }

    # --- App backend: REST API ------------------------------------------------
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        # The app trusts this from loopback by default (TRUST_PROXY) so rate
        # limits are per visitor. nginx on another host/container: set
        # TRUST_PROXY to its address (or a hop count) in the app's .env.
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
        proxy_read_timeout    120s;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
    }

    # --- App backend: the Functions sandbox frame (5.3) -----------------------
    # A function's browser code (m5.browser.run, "js" outputs) runs in an
    # <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" src="/fn-sandbox.html"> — an opaque
    # origin with its own strict CSP, which the app sends. The SPA's CSP above
    # allows framing only this site's own pages (frame-src 'self'); the SPA
    # fallback must not answer this path with index.html.
    location = /fn-sandbox.html {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # --- App backend: Functions webhooks (5.2) --------------------------------
    # https://<domain>/hooks/m/<model>/<token> runs a model from outside (a
    # form, a CI job, another service); each token is checked by the app,
    # optionally with an HMAC over the body. Bodies up to 5 MB, read raw.
    location /hooks/ {
        client_max_body_size 6m;
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host  $host;
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
        proxy_buffering off;
    }

    # --- App backend: Clear & Quit landing (dynamic; sets Clear-Site-Data) ----
    location = /goodbye {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # --- App backend: WebSocket signaling (rate-limited) ----------------------
    location = /ws {
        limit_req  zone=m5cet_ws burst=20 nodelay;
        limit_conn m5cet_conn 20;

        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade           $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection        $connection_upgrade;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_buffering off;
    }

    # --- App backend: Digital Asset Links (6.1) --------------------------------
    # The Android app uses this domain's passkeys; the app answers with the
    # certificates it knows (404 when none) — the SPA fallback must not.
    location = /.well-known/assetlinks.json {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # --- App backend: the phone bridge's audio (6.0) --------------------------
    # WebSockets: the provider streams the call to /media/tel/<token>, the room
    # member's browser takes it at /media/tel/client/<token>. A token is valid
    # only while its bridge session lives; the app refuses anything else.
    location /media/tel/ {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade           $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection        $connection_upgrade;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_buffering off;
    }

    # --- App backend: provider webhooks (Twilio / Telnyx / Vonage call back) --
    # Must be publicly reachable by the providers; each request is signature-
    # verified by the app. Set PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://<this domain> in the app
    # env so Twilio's URL-bound signature matches.
    location /wh/ {
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host  $host;
        proxy_buffering off;
    }

    # --- Operator console API of the app (token-protected) -------------------
    # Live traffic, connections, users, queue, databases and the audit journal
    # (server/admin-api.ts). /api/admin/live is Server-Sent Events: no
    # buffering, long timeout. Restrict it to your IPs like /admin/ below.
    location /api/admin/ {
        # allow 203.0.113.10; deny all;      # <-- recommended
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # --- 6.0: an APK release uploaded from the console (Android › Releases) --
    # The one request that carries a whole APK (up to 300 MB): streamed to the
    # app, which checks the operator's token before reading it.
    location = /api/admin/android/releases/upload {
        # allow 203.0.113.10; deny all;      # <-- as /api/admin/ above
        client_max_body_size 300m;
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_read_timeout 600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 600s;
    }

    # --- Admin API (token-protected) + SSE log stream -------------------------
    # DEFENSE IN DEPTH: the admin API already requires Authorization: Bearer
    # <ADMIN_API_TOKEN>, but restrict it to your IPs too. Uncomment + edit:
    #   allow 203.0.113.10;      # your office / VPN
    #   allow 10.0.0.0/8;        # internal
    #   deny  all;
    location /admin/ {
        # allow 203.0.113.10; deny all;      # <-- recommended, see above
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_admin;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        # /admin/logs/stream is Server-Sent Events — no buffering, long timeout.
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # --- Admin GUI (the standalone admin service serves it at "/") ------------
    # Reachable at https://<domain>/console ; its JS calls <origin>/api/admin/*
    # (live state, the app) and <origin>/admin/* (layout, telephony, plugins).
    location = /console { return 301 /console/; }
    location /console/ {
        # allow 203.0.113.10; deny all;      # <-- restrict like /admin/
        proxy_pass http://m5cet_admin/;      # trailing slash strips the /console/ prefix
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header Connection        "";
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}
